translations.web: Don’t be a terror to me. You are my refuge in the day of evil.
translations.bsb: Do not become a terror to me; You are my refuge in the day of disaster.
translations.kjv: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.
translations.asv: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my refuge in the day of evil.
